policy: Focused exact Monster labels. Canonical typed entity or explicit reviewed alias/variant only. No geographical membership inference; mixed families have reviewed variants and no global Boolean restriction. Generic unresolved identity is separate. Existing pinned known Monster rows re-audited and retained separately.

records.title: Troll
